test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian Playback Singers holds the Guinness world record for singing the highest number of songs in one day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumar Sanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumar Sanu**__

 __
 
• Indian playback singer** Kedarnath Bhattacharaya, **better known by his stage name** Kumar Sanu**, was born on **October 20, 1957**.
 
• In Bollywood, he is referred to as **the King of Melody**.
 
• **Kishore Kumar**, a vocalist, has a big impact on the way he **sings and sounds**.
 
• He is well known for **singing numerous Bollywood and Hindi songs**.
 
• In **1993**, **Kumar Sanu ****holds the Guinness world record** for singing the highest number of **songs in one day**.
 
• He recorded** 28 songs** in one day.
 
• He had received the **Best Male Playback Singer Filmfare Award five times** in a consecutive manner **(1990–1994)**.
 
• He received the** Padma Shri honour** from the Indian government in **2009 for his contributions to Indian music and film**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Along with Hindi, he has performed across **Bengal, Bangladesh, as well as West Bengal, singing in Bengali**, his home tongue, as well as **Marathi, Nepali, Assamese, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Tamil, Punjabi, Bhojpuri, Gujarati, Manipuri, Odia, Chhattisgarhi, Urdu, and Pali**.
 
• **Alka Yagini**__
 __
 
• **Indian playback vocalist** Alka Yagnik, who was **born on March 20, 1966**, specialises in Hindi cinema.
 
• Numerous awards, including **two National Film Awards for Best Female Playback Singer**, have been given to Yagnik.
 
• The** Lata Mangeshkar Award was given to Yagnik in 2017** for her work in the **music industry**.
 
 
 
• **Kavita Krishnamurthy**__
 __
 
• **Sharada is an Indian playback and classical vocalist** also known by the name** Kavita Krishnamurthy or Kavita Subramaniam**.
 
• She has recorded more than **50,000 Songs recorded in 46 different languages**.
 
• She has won the **Padma Shri in 2005 **and **four Filmfare Best Female Playback Singer Awards**, which she won **consecutively from 1995 to 1997**.
 
 
 
• **Udit Narayan**__
 
 
• **Indian playback singer** Udit Narayan was born on **1 December 1955 **and is well known for his work in **Hindi-language movies**.
 
• He has won **five Filmfare Awards and four National Film Awards**.
 
• He has won the **Padma Shri in 2009**, and **Padma Bhushan in 2016**.
